consolidated_findings.evidence: Neither X-Frame-Options nor frame-ancestors in Content-Security-Policy was found. (Observed across 2 crawled pages on example.com: https://example.com/, https://example.com/s.js)
consolidated_findings.remediation: Use CSP frame-ancestors (preferred) or X-Frame-Options to limit where pages may be framed.

consolidated_findings.title: [Nuclei] Weak Cipher Suites Detection
consolidated_findings.remediation: A weak cipher is defined as an encryption/decryption algorithm that uses a key of insufficient length. Using an insufficient length for a key in an encryption/decryption algorithm opens up the possibility (or probability) that the encryption scheme could be broken.
